channels.name: Today in Energy
channels.description: Oil, electricity and fuel markets through the lens of U.S. energy data.

headlines.title: How does EIA account for small differences between energy supply and demand data?
headlines.summary: EIA explains why more than 60 surveys can produce slightly different totals for energy supply and demand, even though the two should balance.

headlines.title: Hydropower generation in the Southwest fell to record lows this summer
headlines.summary: Drought in the Colorado River Basin reduced Southwest hydropower generation. Output from April through August was 19% below the same period a year earlier.

headlines.title: EIA forecasts Alaskan crude oil production to grow 13% in 2027
headlines.summary: Two North Slope projects are driving Alaska’s rebound. EIA expects output to reach 505,000 barrels a day in 2027, the highest level since 2014.

channels.name: Energy Research
channels.description: Reporting on the people and technology changing how energy is produced and stored.

headlines.title: Addressing nuclear challenges, from radiation detection to power in space
headlines.summary: MIT’s Jake Hecla is studying how to cool reactors for space missions and how to detect nuclear material.

headlines.title: Energy, prosperity, emissions, and innovation: A decarbonization progress report
headlines.summary: At MIT’s energy conference, Breakthrough Energy’s Eric Toone assessed progress on cutting emissions and where further innovation is needed.

headlines.title: Powering up for a pivotal moment
headlines.summary: MIT researchers discussed technologies moving into service today, alongside longer-term work in nuclear energy and quantum computing.

channels.name: Utility Dive
channels.description: Electric utilities, grid investment and power markets.

headlines.title: Data center slowdown would raise risks for utility investments
headlines.summary: Orennia flags planned data-center projects in Texas, Ohio and Georgia as particularly exposed to a slowdown.

headlines.title: Most states fail ‘community power’ test, advocacy group says
headlines.summary: The Institute for Local Self-Reliance grades state policies for local energy control and virtual power plants.

headlines.title: Batteries included: A practical checklist for storage owners, operators to boost reliability
headlines.summary: A guest contributor outlines how storage operators can use telemetry and escalation procedures to respond to grid conditions.

channels.name: GitHub Changelog

headlines.summary: GitHub expanded Fusion to more Copilot surfaces, added models and published two Terminal-Bench results for comparison.

headlines.title: GitHub Copilot app, Microsoft Ignite releases
headlines.summary: GitHub’s Ignite announcement adds support for Azure DevOps repositories and GitHub Enterprise Server in the Copilot app.

headlines.summary: Cloudflare uses Quad9’s departure to examine how DNS blocking affects public resolvers and access to the internet.

headlines.title: Kitesurf is now open source
headlines.summary: Cloudflare released the code for its experimental browser engine for AI agents. Developers can run it locally or on Workers.

headlines.title: Adapting to AI penetration testing orchestrators: The Modern Security Model
headlines.summary: Cloudflare reports on automated testing against exposed services and describes defensive changes for infrastructure teams.

channels.description: Reporting on enterprise computing, software and the semiconductor industry.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang thrilled to be spending time with family, but will retake leadership burden if Nvidia asks

headlines.summary: The latest TotalView release adds Python to its parallel debugging support for high-performance computing.

channels.name: FDA Announcements
channels.description: Agency announcements on medicines, devices and public health.

headlines.title: FDA Launches the Global Reliance Disclosure Program to Expand Patient Access to Medicines Worldwide
headlines.summary: The FDA announced a program to help health authorities worldwide make use of its drug and biologic approval decisions.

headlines.title: FDA Approves First Drug Shown to Help Patients with Infantile-Onset Niemann-Pick Disease Type C Live Longer
headlines.summary: The agency approved adrabetadex after evidence showed a survival benefit in patients with the infantile-onset form of the disease.

headlines.title: FDA Approves First Factor Xla Inhibitor to Help Prevent Stroke in Certain Adults at High Risk
headlines.summary: The FDA approved asundexian alongside antiplatelet therapy for certain adults after an ischemic stroke or high-risk transient ischemic attack.

headlines.title: Waves that clear waste from the brain during sleep are impaired in older adults
headlines.summary: Researchers found age-related changes in the fluid waves involved in clearing brain waste. They plan to study whether increasing fluid flow during sleep could help.

headlines.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop a wearable monitor for early disease detection
headlines.summary: ARPA-H awarded the team up to $38 million to develop a wearable patch that tracks biomarkers associated with heart failure and sepsis.

headlines.title: Featured video: Changing the conversation about endometriosis
headlines.summary: A documentary follows MIT researchers studying endometriosis and efforts to develop treatments for the condition.

headlines.title: ‘Selling and marketing snake oil’: The debate over compounded GLP-1s
headlines.summary: Conference speakers debated access, cost and safety concerns around compounded GLP-1 medications.

headlines.title: Updated HIPAA privacy law sets rules for sharing health data with apps
